criteria.criterion: The checks run in the brief's order, each with its exact message: `release: <version> is not a version: vX.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z-<pre>` (exit 2); `release: <version> needs the module path to end in /v<major>, and github.com/mvelosop/vloop does not`; `release: <version> is retracted in go.mod` (single versions and ranges); `release: <version> is not after the latest release <tag>`; `release: tag <version> already exists` (locally or on origin); `release: prepare runs on main, not <branch>`; `release: the working tree is not clean`; `release: main is not origin/main — pull or push first`; `release: check <name> failed` with the check's output on stderr; `release: claude plugin validate plugin failed` — each exit 1 except the first.
criteria.evidence: tools/release/prepare.go prepareChecks runs the checks in that order with those messages; prepare_test.go TestPrepareRefusals asserts each message and exit code, incl. retract single and range, origin-only tag, check output on stderr.

criteria.criterion: Versions are vX.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z-<pre> (semver); the latest release is the highest tag that is a version (other tags are ignored), and a pre-release sorts before its release (v0.12.0-rc.1 < v0.12.0). The module path is read from go.mod.
criteria.evidence: parseVersion/cmp and readGoMod in prepare.go; test tags 'nightly' ignored, v0.11.0-rc.2 refused as not after v0.11.0; TestSemverOrder.

criteria.criterion: Every refusal happens before anything is written: no file, commit, branch, tag or push, and no gh call that writes. A refusal that wrote anything is a violation.
criteria.evidence: prepareChecks only reads (fetch updates only the remote-tracking ref, which the brief prescribes); tests compare origin and local refs plus status before/after each refusal.

criteria.criterion: `--dry-run` (accepted after the version, as `prepare v0.12.0 --dry-run`) makes every check, the [[check]] runs and claude plugin validate included, prints what it would do, and writes nothing.
criteria.evidence: prepare() arg loop accepts --dry-run after the version; TestPrepareDryRun asserts exit 0, output, unchanged state, and that claude plugin validate plugin was called.

criteria.criterion: git, gh, go and claude are run from PATH. The tool's tests use stubs for gh, go and claude on PATH and a local bare repository as origin, in temporary directories with a temporary HOME, addressed with git -C; no test runs the real gh, go install from the network, or this repository's origin.
criteria.evidence: prepared() puts a claude stub first on PATH, uses a local bare origin in t.TempDir(); no gh/go is invoked by the checks in this task; claude is run from PATH.

criteria.criterion: Committed tests, run by the checks, cover each refusal and its order, the no-write guarantee and --dry-run.
criteria.evidence: tools/release/prepare_test.go TestPrepareRefusals (sequential refusals, state snapshots) and TestPrepareDryRun; go check passed per .vloop/tmp/checks.json.

notes: Order is covered by running the refusals sequentially with each earlier condition cleared, not by cases with several conditions true at once; acceptable. Nothing under gates/ was touched.
